questions.prompt: How many total litres of milk are produced globally in a single year?
reasoning: There are roughly 270 million dairy cows in the world.
An average dairy cow produces about 3,300 litres of milk per year.
Multiplying the number of cows by the average annual yield gives approximately 900 billion litres.

questions.prompt: How many individual paper pages are in all the books borrowed from public libraries across the United States in a single year?
reasoning: Public libraries in the US handle roughly 2 billion book checkouts per year.
The average library book has about 300 pages.
Multiplying the number of checkouts by the average page count gives roughly 600 billion pages.

questions.prompt: How many individual stamps are sold by national postal services worldwide in a single year?
reasoning: There are about 8 billion people on Earth, and postal systems still handle billions of letters and packages annually.
Assuming an average of about 12 postal items or stamp purchases per person globally each year.
Multiplying 8 billion people by 12 gives roughly 100 billion stamps.
